offering_description.value: Bowman provides engineering and technical consulting to public and private clients in real estate, energy, infrastructure and environmental management. Its multidisciplinary teams deliver projects from planning and design through construction.

quotes.quote: Bowman is a trusted, multi-disciplinary consulting firm offering a broad range of real estate, energy, infrastructure, and environmental management solutions to both public and private clients across the country. From large commercial developments, to master planned communities, to local transportation projects, Bowman delivers outstanding project results, builds long-lasting relationships and leverages the growth of our organization to serve the constantly changing needs of our clients.

With national resources across multiple disciplines, Bowman’s agile and integrated teams have a keen understanding of marketplace trends and are experts in providing value-based solutions to help expedite timelines, minimize costs, reduce oversight and navigate even the toughest of municipalities to maximize the potential of the land. We focus on results and provide our clients with peace of mind by exceeding expectations and providing a turn-key experience from planning, design and on through construction.

primary_services.value: civil engineering and design; site planning and surveying; environmental due diligence; zoning and permitting support; construction administration

quotes.quote: Bowman has provided professional services for more than 300 car wash projects. Bowman also performs traffic impact studies for car wash sites throughout the country.

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: site development subject to municipal zoning ordinances, permitting and city approvals

quotes.quote: Retail development is a significant land use in virtually every community. From neighborhood strip malls, auto dealerships, gas stations and big-box developments, it is a competitive market and often complicated process. From navigating due diligence and site availability, to zoning ordinances, public hearings and the permitting process, commercial developments are often faced with time-consuming roadblocks that can affect a project’s speed to market.

These projects typically include a new building and parking lot and Bowman is generally responsible for designing all onsite utilities, grading and erosion control, coordination with adjacent land owners, and facilitating city approvals.
